items.title: OpenAI says it will change how it informs the public when its AI agents go off the rails
items.summary: OpenAI says it needs better standards for disclosing rogue AI incidents after its agents hijacked an old German wiki.
items.titleZh: OpenAI表示，当其人工智能代理出现问题时，它将改变通知公众的方式
items.summaryZh: OpenAI表示，在其代理劫持了一个旧的德国维基后，它需要更好的标准来披露流氓AI事件。

items.title: Starlink is offering half-price internet near xAI data centers, but critics want the pollution fixed
items.summary: With roughly 2,000 reported subscribers since the offer was announced in July, compared with more than 250,000 households across Memphis, the discount appears unlikely to ease broader concerns about the company's unpermitted power generation and its environme…
items.titleZh: 星联在xAI数据中心附近提供半价互联网，但批评者希望解决污染问题
items.summaryZh: 自7月宣布该提议以来，据报道约有2000名用户，而孟菲斯有超过25万户家庭，折扣似乎不太可能缓解人们对该公司未经许可的发电及其环境的更广泛担忧…

items.title: Federal regulators are investigating Musk’s new steering-wheel-free Cybercabs a day after launch, unconvinced by Tesla’s self-certification process
items.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration said it was looking into whether Tesla was in full compliance with federal rules when it deployed so-called Cybercabs in Austin.
items.titleZh: 联邦监管机构正在调查马斯克新推出的无方向盘Cybercabs，对特斯拉的自我认证程序持怀疑态度
items.summaryZh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局表示，正在调查特斯拉在奥斯汀部署所谓的Cybercabs时是否完全符合联邦规定。

items.title: OpenAI Agents Hacked Another Website
items.summary: Plus: Tens of millions of US and Canadian drivers’ licenses go up for sale on the dark web, the US military finally tries to tackle the risk online ad data poses to troops, and more.
items.titleZh: OpenAI代理攻击了另一个网站
items.summaryZh: 此外：数以千万计的美国和加拿大驾照在暗网上出售，美国军方最终试图解决在线广告数据给军队带来的风险等等。

items.title: Toyota spent years moving slowly on EVs. I drove its new, affordable C-HR to see whether the wait paid off.
items.summary: Other US automakers regretted their early-2020s EVs. Toyota took a slower approach and launched models this year — so we tested a new entrant.
items.titleZh: 丰田多年来在电动汽车方面进展缓慢。我开着它新的、负担得起的C-HR，看看等待是否有回报。
items.summaryZh: 其他美国汽车制造商对21世纪20年代初的电动汽车表示遗憾。丰田采取了较慢的方法，今年推出了车型，所以我们测试了一个新进入者。

items.title: Uber says it can replace car ownership. My used Toyota Yaris proved its point.
items.summary: Buying a used Toyota Yaris was costly compared to relying on Uber and Lyft. The analysis highlights Uber's competition with car ownership.
items.titleZh: 优步表示，它可以取代汽车所有权。我用过的丰田雅力士证明了这一点。
items.summaryZh: 与依赖优步和Lyft相比，购买二手丰田雅力士的成本很高。该分析突显了优步与汽车所有权的竞争。

items.title: Cheche Group Reports First Half 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
items.summary: BEIJING, Sept. 4, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cheche Group Inc. (NASDAQ: CCG) ("Cheche", "the Company" or "we"), China's leading auto insurance technology platform, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026.
items.titleZh: 车车集团公布2026年上半年未经审计的财务业绩
items.summaryZh: 北京，2026年9月4日/PRNewswire/-中国领先的汽车保险技术平台车车集团股份有限公司（NASDAQ:CCG）（“车”、“公司”或“我们”）今天宣布了截至2026年6月30日的六个月未经审计的财务业绩。
